data.rationale: The proposal matches the true workflow's goal, order and parameters (BOOK > Map search, origin, search type, flexible dates, Search, open a result), but it makes the search type and flexible dates optional and doesn't say how to set them, and it adds a stray "trip type" parameter in the description. An automation could still be built from the spec, though the date-range selection and the list-of-results toggle would need to be filled in.
